tasks.short: Communicate hospital care changes to primary care physicians

steps.what: Reconcile admission, treatment changes and follow-up information for primary care
Draft the continuity message for the primary care physician

loop.purpose: Draft a continuity message from reconciled clinical facts
loop.input: Checked brief with source references, treatment changes and explicit follow-up responsibilities
loop.output: Draft retaining uncertainty and action ownership
loop.check: Hospitalist checks each clinical statement, medication change, pending result and follow-up responsibility against source record
loop.stop: One draft; missing source support or conflicting facts returns to manual composition
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template should be tested first; free-text clinical narrative still needs careful wording

steps.what: Verify and communicate the message, resolving primary care questions

tasks.design: Use the clinical record system {OTHER} for source review and a bounded draft in {DOCS} for written continuity messages. The hospitalist reconciles the facts, checks the exact final message and communicates personally when questions or urgency require discussion.
tasks.previous_blocker: Continuity messages combine scattered clinical facts with narrative explanation.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded clinical-letter drafting can shorten wording after the clinician has checked the source facts.
tasks.still_hard: Pending results, medication changes and ambiguous follow-up ownership require clinical judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The hospitalist recognises what the receiving physician must act on and resolves uncertainty directly.
tasks.altitude: Less message composition; reconciliation, release and continuity responsibility remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify ownership of a follow-up handoff
reach.learn: Primary care communication and nursing follow-up boundaries

evidence.claim: Juvoly drafts referral letters; this supports clinical-letter drafting capability, not validated hospital continuity messages or measured savings here.
The continuity-message adaptation and its time estimate are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is communication at admission, change or discharge, not making treatment decisions or recording them originally.

In s1 the hospitalist captures patient and encounter IDs, source versions, admission/change/discharge event, reconciled changes, pending results, action owner, due date and verified recipient. All 30 hours remain; missing or conflicting facts trigger manual clarification and drafting.
Test native clinical message templates first. No automated diagnosis, medication reconciliation or unsupervised external sending is proposed.
Allow five focal hours for template and failure review beyond routine message checks. The scenario requires written composition today; calls retain their time.
research_questions: Does draft checking preserve pending results and explicit follow-up ownership while reducing net composition time?

approvals.approved_version: Exact final message, patient/encounter, clinical source snapshot and primary care recipient; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R82.5 gross17.5 minus5 upkeep =12.5 net. High assumes substantial narrative composition; low covers telephone-heavy work or drafts needing complete rewriting. Clinical and discussion time remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Participate in continuing education and practise applying new knowledge

tasks.design: Retain active learning, discussion and skill practice. Existing course materials in {LMS} support participation; generating summaries does not establish the same learning in less time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Learning requires engagement, practice and critical appraisal.
tasks.enabler_now: Document summarisation does not establish a reduction in education time.
tasks.still_hard: Applying new knowledge appropriately requires clinical context.
tasks.human_edge: The physician recognises limitations and tests understanding against practice.
tasks.altitude: Professional learning remains an explicit part of the week.

reach.task: Identify difficult inpatient scenarios for teaching

evidence.claim: Retaining active education participation is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is participation and learning; course search, enrolment and certificate entry are outside it.
No machine completion flag or assumed structured learning record is introduced.
Existing course facilities suffice; no custom tool is proposed.
Zero upkeep because the learning activity is unchanged.
unknowns: Education formats and required practical activities
research_questions: Which learning activities improve application in inpatient cases?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Learning remains fully counted despite the amplify prior; no administrative baseline is inferred.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct quality improvement and safety work

steps.what: Assess safety problems and choose quality improvement priorities
Direct improvement projects and agree safe changes with staff

tasks.design: Retain clinical assessment of improvement priorities and direct leadership of safety changes. Existing evidence in {DOCS} supports discussion; no automatically inferred cause or safety decision is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Improvement requires understanding context and changing real practice.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafting technology does not establish safer change leadership with less physician effort.
tasks.still_hard: Observed patterns may not identify causes, and interventions can have unintended effects.
tasks.human_edge: The physician challenges causal assumptions and secures workable clinical changes.
tasks.altitude: Safety leadership and decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify clinical feasibility of improvement actions

evidence.claim: Keeping clinical improvement leadership human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is the hospitalist's assessment and leadership; data collection by quality staff is existing outside work, not a new automated saving.
No free structured incident cause or risk score is assumed.
No custom tool is proposed; retain existing quality evidence and meetings.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes.
unknowns: Existing quality data and project responsibilities
research_questions: Which decisions require direct clinical leadership rather than report production?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Assessment and change leadership retain time; no hypothetical reporting share is removed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct short-stay or specialty unit operations

steps.what: Review unit capacity, patient needs and operational constraints
Direct unit operations and resolve clinical resource conflicts

tasks.design: Retain review of the unit-status system {OTHER} and direct operational leadership. The hospitalist weighs clinical needs with the team; no automatic patient allocation or staffing decision is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Unit operations combine changing acuity, capacity and competing demands.
tasks.enabler_now: A status display supports decisions without removing leadership work.
tasks.still_hard: Exceptions can invalidate simple capacity rules.
tasks.human_edge: The hospitalist balances clinical risks and negotiates feasible action.
tasks.altitude: Unit leadership and operational responsibility remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Retaining clinical unit leadership is an E1 model-knowledge assessment.

assumptions: Boundary is reviewing existing status and directing operations; generating staffing and bed records is separate unchanged work.
The unit-status system is {OTHER}; no automatic allocation or free structured acuity classification is assumed.
Existing tools remain; no custom optimisation system is proposed.
Zero incremental upkeep because the task does not change.
unknowns: Unit authority, capacity constraints and status quality
research_questions: Which operational conflicts require direct clinical negotiation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Existing dashboard runtime is not physician effort and creates no new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce written handoff composition where it exists while preserving clinical reconciliation, education, safety leadership and unit decisions.
reach: Help quality coordinators test clinical feasibility
role.ambitious_version: A hospitalist who makes continuity responsibilities clear and protects time for care coordination and safe unit leadership.
